body.statement: Let \(X_{n1},\ldots,X_{nk_n}\) be independent mean-zero real random variables.  If \(\sum_iE[X_{ni}^2]\to V\in(0,\infty)\) and, for every \(\epsilon>0\), \(\sum_iE[X_{ni}^2\mathbf 1\{|X_{ni}|>\epsilon\}]\to0\), then \(\sum_iX_{ni}\Rightarrow N(0,V)\).
